films.name: Musk
films.description: MUSK is an incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded “inventor-entrepreneur” who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: A Talent for Murder
films.description: The smoldering chamber thriller, A TALENT FOR MURDER, from Anton Corbijn (Control) stars Academy Award winner Helen Mirren and Alden Ehrenreich (Weapons) as opponents in a strange confrontation between a youthful literary agent and “The Talented Mr. Ripley” author Patricia Highsmith. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: Dao
films.description: French Senegalese filmmaker Alain Gomis’s ecstatic epic, DAO, plunges headfirst into two separate yet intrinsically interconnected ceremonies: a memorial in Guinea-Bissau and a wedding in Paris, which Gomis cuts between with kinetic abandonment. A Janus Films release

events.name: Once Upon a Time in Harlem

films.name: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.description: Genre-defying director William Greaves searches for the divine origins of his own creativity at a cocktail party he masterminded in 1972 for the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance. Directed by David Greaves, William’s son, ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM celebrates the creative geniuses who came together to relate during a rapidly shifting cultural landscape. A NEON release

films.name: A Bit of Light
films.description: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, A BIT OF LIGHT follows a disillusioned Iranian doctor who loses faith in the future. Determined to end his life, he spends one final day visiting his siblings and mother to prepare them for his departure. Their compassion, care, and companionship slowly reconcile him with reality.

events.description: Includes ticket to Opening Night Party at Site Santa Fe

films.name: In Memoriam (Opening Night)
films.description:
What is the one thing that a dying man feels will prove his life was worth something? A place in the Academy Awards® “In Memoriam” segment, of course. IN MEMORIAM is a unique, heartfelt dramedy about waking up in life before it’s too late. A vain actor learns he has six months to live and becomes obsessed with making the Academy Awards “In Memoriam” montage, sparking a hilarious and affecting exploration of ego, humility, and legacy. Writer/ Director Rob Burnett and Producer/Star Marc Maron in Attendance

Ticket includes Opening Night Party at Site Santa Fe at 9pm.

events.name: World Indigenous Shorts
events.description: Presented by Institute of American Indian Arts and Cherokee Film

films.name: Faceless
films.description: An Indigenous man navigates three parallel realities along the Birrarung-Ga in Naarm: a rough sleeper, an aspiring actor, and a mining corporation employee. As he moves between radically different worlds, the boundaries between them begin to collapse, forcing him to confront the identities he performs and the worlds he inhabits in FACELESS.

films.name: MIRUMIRU (BUBBLE)
films.description: A determined elderly Shorty attempts to save his ailing wife’s memories from literally escaping her mind, so she doesn’t forget him before the end in MIRUMIRU (BUBBLE).

films.name: Q-Pop
films.description: Q-POP follows 23-year-old Quechua artist Lenin Tamayo, creator of Q-Pop, a genre blending K-Pop and Quechua, an Indigenous language fighting to survive among younger generations. Through his music, Lenin sets out to preserve and revitalize the language of his ancestors.

films.name: Remigia's Lessons
films.description: In the hems of the Sierra Madre in the Philippines, where the land stretches beneath changing skies, Nanay Remigia, an elder of the Indigenous Dumagat tribe, lives in harmony with the mountain and forest. She grapples with fending off challenges as circumstances change in the region in REMIGIA’S LESSONS.

films.name: SILA
films.description: SILA was created in close collaboration with a local children’s home and filmed in the Greenlandic language; the coming-of-age story traces identity, tradition, loss, and resilience. Living alongside its protagonists, the film observes a fragile passage between deep cultural roots and an uncertain, rapidly changing world.

films.description: CLARISSA reconceptualize's Virginia Woolf’s "Mrs Dalloway". Set in modern day Lagos, Nigeria, the film follows a high society wife (Sophie Okonedo) preparing for a party that will put her face to face with an old flame. She spends the evening reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend. Stars Sophie Okonedo, David Oyelowo, India Amarteifio, Toheeb Jimoh, Nikki Amuka-Bird, and Ayo Edebiri. A NEON release

events.name: Opening Night Party
events.description: Join us for our stellar Opening Night Gala at Site Santa Fe catered by Santa Fe Chef. Music by Party Girl DJs.

films.name: Barbara Forever
films.description: BARBARA FOREVER explores the films, archive, and ongoing cultural impact of experimental filmmaker Barbara Hammer, revealing her ingenious lifelong artistic effort to create and record lesbian histories, personal and societal, spanning four decades. The film centers Hammer as a prism of the cultural ecosystems around her and breaks taboos around female sexuality, aging, illness, and queer love. Winner of Jonathan Oppenheim Editing Award for U.S. Documentary at Sundance.

films.name: Heysel 85
films.description: Violence erupts before the 1985 European Cup Final between Liverpool and Juventus at Brussels’ Heysel Stadium, killing 39 people. HEYSEL 85 follows the mayor’s daughter and an Italian journalist as they are drawn into the heart of the tragedy, caught between professional duty, family loyalty, and moral responsibility.

films.name: Everytime
films.description: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio takes a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap in EVERYTIME. Germany's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®

films.name: All of a Sudden
films.description: ALL OF A SUDDEN tells the story of Marie-Lou (Virginie Efira), a director of a care facility for the elderly, who strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari (Tao Okamoto), a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. Japan's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A NEON release

events.name: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff

films.name: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
films.description: CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF STAR STUFF is an intimate portrait of the visionary astronomer, author, and television star whose groundbreaking ideas transformed our understanding of the cosmos and human existence. With unprecedented access to his extensive personal archive, the film explores Sagan’s cosmic love story with partner Ann Druyan and his evolution as a father, husband, and scientist. A National Geographic Documentary Films release

films.name: Look Back
films.description: From director Hirokazu Kore-eda(Shoplifters, SFiFF 2017) LOOK BACK follows Fujina, precocious and popular; she’s happy hanging with friends and drawing weekly strips for her grade school publication. One day she meets her match in Kyomoto, a homeschooled student with a dazzling technique. Soon, the two are close collaborators, creating manga together and enjoying great success. Everything is wonderful until one day, Kyomoto breaks the partnership. A GKIDS Films Release

films.name: The General
films.description: Johnnie loves his train ("The General") and Annabelle Lee. When the Civil War begins, he is turned down for service because he's more valuable as an engineer. Annabelle thinks it's because he's a coward. Union spies capture The General with Annabelle on board. Johnny must rescue both his loves in the Buster Keaton classic, THE GENERAL.

films.name: Ni-Naadamaadiz: Red Power Rising
films.description: Despite it lasting 28 days in 1974, there is only eight minutes of footage about an Indigenous youth-led armed occupation in Kenora, Ontario. NI-NAADAMAADIZ: RED POWER RISING follows the charismatic Louis Cameron and the Ojibwe Warriors Society, who fought for Indigenous human rights and were joined by members of the American Indian Movement, who crossed the border to join directly after Wounded Knee.

films.name: The Baddest Speechwriter of All
films.description: Now 95, Martin Luther King Jr.’s lawyer and speechwriter reflects on the personal cost and surprising truths of making history, offering an intimate insider’s view of the Civil Rights Movement in THE BADDEST SPEECHWRITER OF ALL

films.name: Minotaur
films.description: MINOTAUR takes place in Russia, 2022. When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures and an increasingly unstable world, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence. France's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Mubi release

films.name: Lady
films.description: In LADY, A determined taxi driver in Lagos forms an unexpected bond with a group of free-spirited women, leading her into a world of friendship and self-discovery despite the risks along the way. As Lady becomes entangled in their world, the nights grow more dangerous, and the city presses harder against old wounds she’s never confronted.

films.name: threeASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE
films.description: Filmed over five years with breathtaking intimacy, first-time feature documentary director Sean Ono Lennon, THREEASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE has continually pushed the boundaries of what fashion can be for more than 25 years. Gabi Asfour, Angela Donhauser, and Adi Gil, the threeASFOUR collaborators, navigate the impossible tension between art and commerce, choosing art at every turn. Producer Beth Levison and Editor Jenny Golden in Attendance.

films.name: What Price Glory
films.description: U.S. Marine sergeants, Quirt and Flagg, are inveterate romantic rivals on peacetime assignments in China and the Philippines. In 1917, W.W.I. brings them to France, where Flagg, now a captain, takes up with flirtatious Charmaine, the innkeeper’s daughter, in WHAT PRICE GLORY.

films.name: People of the West  (Episode 1)
films.description: On Kumeyaay/Ipai land in 1542, PEOPLE OF THE WEST - EPISODE 1 follows a teenager’s coming-of-age ceremony that collides with the arrival of explorer Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo. The village greets the strangers in cautious diplomacy until Spain’s “Requerimiento”. A clash over fishing rights sparks violence, and two children are abducted as “interpreters,” foreshadowing centuries of dispossession.

films.name: Closure
films.description: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive. CLOSURE transcends the true-crime cliché as this masterful study of obsession documents a father’s quest for answers in the wake of his teenage son’s disappearance. Director Michal Marczak and Executive producer James Costa in attendance.

films.name: Buried Under Years of Dust
films.description: BURIED UNDER YEARS OF DUST traces the remarkable journey of Emily Grodin, a woman silenced by autism, finally finding her voice. Despite Emily’s increasing frustration, physical outbursts, and violent meltdowns, Emily’s parents never abandoned hope that their daughter would one day share her thoughts, feelings, and deep intelligence.

films.name: Cosmic Symphony
films.description: Four iconic instruments, including the Wizard of Oz and Star is Born pianos, all lost in the 2025 Los Angeles Fires, are celebrated by their musicians, culminating in an animated send-off towards an imagined future in COSMIC SYMPHONY.

films.name: My Friend Sam
films.description: Singer-songwriter Regina Spektor’s life changed forever when, as a child, she was taken under the wing of musicians Sonia Vargas and Samuel Marder. Now, Marder, a widower and Holocaust survivor, is speaking out about his painful past, with Spektor at his side in MY FRIEND SAM.

events.name: Coffee Chat with Michael McGarrity
events.description: New Mexican author Michael McGarrity discusses his series of crime novels, as well as writing, craft, and creativity, focusing on the author’s voice. Moderated by Mary-Charlotte Domandi.

films.name: Burn, Scar
films.description: BURN, SCAR delves into the aftermath of the prescribed burn set by the U.S. Forest Service in the mountains of northern New Mexico in 2022 that would escape its firelines and spiral out of control to become the largest wildfire in the state’s history. The film captures families devastated by the fire, Forest Service crews struggling to move forward, and climate adaptation. Director Hillary Bachelder in attendance.

films.name: Gentle Monster
films.description: GENTLE MONSTER follows Lucy(Léa Seydoux), a concert pianist, who has just relocated her family to a country house in the hope of easing her husband’s severe burnout. Before they can settle in, an early morning police visit tears their world apart. Lucy must face the situation alone, trapped between the man she loves and the fear of what he may have done. A Netflix release

films.name: Coyotes
films.description: A Palestinian surgeon drives home after a long night shift, but little does she know that a commute through a desolate West Bank road will change her forever in COYOTES.

films.name: I Will Be Alright
films.description: A young girl, having fled the regime of Iran, disguises herself as a Statue of Liberty to earn a few coins in I WILL BE ALRIGHT.

films.name: Odessa
films.description: In the wake of WWII, a devoted father guides his fleeing family across the Dolomites in ODESSA. He is gentle with his child and running for a reason.

films.name: Swallow
films.description: A brutal classroom encounter leaves substitute teacher Stella humiliated, falsely accused, and fighting for her reputation, while colleagues offer little support. When an injured swallow becomes trapped inside the college, its struggle for freedom begins to echo her own. SWALLOW is inspired by true events.

films.name: Vultures
films.description: VULTURES shows the volatile moments after a car crash. Before the authorities arrive, a hot-headed yet desperate tow truck driver fiercely protects his tow. But the situation quickly spirals out of his control.

events.name: IAIA Shorts
events.description: BUFFALO RELEASE by Ana Corn, YOUR TURN by Avery Hale & Sunshine Eaton, CHECKUP by Ezra Dosela, I AM LIFE - CREATOR OF WORLDS by Kanesia McGlashan-Price, THE LIGHT THAT STAYS by Ashley Reese Meanus, GRAND ENTRY by Avery Hale & Sunshine Eaton

films.name: Variety's 10 Screenwriters to Watch
films.description: Variety's annual 10 Screenwriters to Watch list recognizes the honorees at this year’s Santa Fe International Film Festival. This year marks Variety’s third year in partnership with SFIFF to present its annual Screenwriters to Watch list. As Variety continues to celebrate up-and-coming scribes, the 10 selected will be spotlighted in a panel conversation at the festival Oct. 15, moderated by Variety's senior entertainment writer Angelique Jackson.

films.name: Fjord
films.description: Winner of the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival, FJORD tells the story of the Gheorghius (Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve), a devout Romanian Norwegian couple who resettle in a village set in a distant fjord where they befriend their new neighbours, the Halbergs. When Elia Gheorghiu shows up at school with some bruises on her body, the community thinks the Gheorghius’ traditional and questionable education approach might have something to do with it. Romania's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A NEON Release

films.name: The Liberation
films.description: Rita (Carrie Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (Lily James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. When her daughters Ella (Bella Ramsey) and Jo (Odessa Young) arrive unexpectedly, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: A Hundred and Fifteen Times Yes!
films.description: In the not-so-distant future of A HUNDRED AND FIFTEEN TIMES YES!, Martin is a lonely autistic man craving connection. He turns to Eterna Luv, a service that lets you live out any experience, at a cost.

films.name: Circle the Block
films.description: A man confronts his one-night stand after catching him in a lie in CIRCLE THE BLOCK.

films.name: Into the Chutes
films.description: Lee Knight, a queer, Black, nonbinary athlete, struggles to overcome injury and adversity to pursue their dream of becoming a competitive Bull Rider in the International Gay Rodeo circuit, while at the same time helping shatter rigid stereotypes of rodeo culture in INTO THE CHUTES.

films.name: Lucrecia & The Witches
films.description: Lucrecia, a superstitious singer in a drag queen bar, hits a streak of bad luck right before her audition for a famous TV show. Nervous about making it onto the show, she decides to get a miracle cleanse from a pair of witches in LUCRECIA & THE WITCHES.

films.name: Rainbow Rider
films.description: In the volatile moments after a car crash and before the authorities arrive, a hot-headed yet desperate tow truck driver fiercely protects his tow in RAINBOW RIDER. The situation quickly spirals out of his control.

films.name: So Be It
films.description: SO BE IT is an animated documentary offering a rare and tender portrait of lifelong queer love. Through candid conversation, the film shares the stories of 5 LGBTQIA+ couples reflecting on resilience, commitment, and the privilege it is to love and be loved.

films.name: UnderTheInfluence
films.description: In #UNDERTHEINFLUENCE, Brooke Haven (Cassidy Freeman) and Chelsea Haven (Alexandra Renzo), the daughters of the first mommy blogger, agree to star in a reality TV show based on their childhood fame as the daughters of the first real mommy blogger. They quickly learn reality is negotiable, relationships are for sale, and sisterhood is the only thing that can save them.

films.name: Coffy
films.description: COFFY is a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Using both her wiles and deadly weaponry, Coffy sets about ridding the streets of drug dealers, pimps, and deviants.

films.name: Amygdala
films.description: When Zoe is attacked by a mysterious woman and begins to experience strange visions, she has only minutes to get help or else uncover the mystery behind the madness that surrounds her in AMYGDALA.

films.name: Frontera
films.description: FRONTERA follows a boy fleeing a tragedy in the US who crosses south into post-revolutionary 1923 Sonora, Mexico, taking refuge with a healer woman who prepares for the spiritual chaos of a solar eclipse. As he fumbles to outlast his grief, she readies herself to meet the total darkness.

films.name: Last Ditch
films.description: Near the end of the 1847 Taos Revolt, two rogues hiding in an irrigation ditch must choose between freedom and risking their lives one last time to save a child from a brutal U.S. army scout.

films.name: Meathead
films.description: The titular MEATHEAD is expecting a few easy bucks from a boring house-sitting job. If only they’d read the house rules! This darkly comedic horror short satirizes youthful apathy and the soul-sucking jobs we take just to survive.

films.name: Red Razor On Soft Skin
films.description: RED RAZOR ON SOFT SKIN is a giallo horror short film about a timid son forced by his mother to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. From writer-director-editor Luca Silver comes a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction, hand-crafted by Dust Wave Collective in Albuquerque, NM.

films.name: Shroomery
films.description: When Lacey's boyfriend, Miles, buys the wrong type of 'shrooms' in the hopes of reviving their ailing relationship, the two must team up to fight off a growth of malicious mushrooms that have overtaken their refrigerator in SHROOMERY.

films.name: Valentina's Tax
films.description: An aspiring finance-bro assumes he’s in control when a woman walks into his bar, but her presence is no accident; it’s a calculated move to collect a debt in VALENTINA'S TAX.

films.name: We Didn't Know Why
films.description: Two women, speeding down a lone desert highway, confront death, birth, and rebirth in WE DIDN'T KNOW WHY.

films.name: Bedford Park
films.description: When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, Audrey (Moon Choi) meets Eli (Son Sukku), the man responsible for the accident. Writer-director Stephanie Ahn’s feature debut, BEDFORD PARK, explores the complexities of diasporic experience through a chance encounter between two thirtysomething, second-generation Korean Americans, tracking their relationship as it moves from circumstantial to friendly to romantic. A Sony Pictures Classics release

films.name: Campeón Gabacho (Gringo Champion)
films.description: A determined Mexican migrant boxes his way through challenges and discrimination in America, using his fighting spirit and optimism to rise above adversity and find unexpected success in Campeón Gabacho (Gringo Champion).

films.name: A Man Who Takes Pictures of Flowers
films.description: Jung Myung Kim, a photographer who has dedicated over 40 years to capturing wildflowers in Korea, shares his story of pursuing his passion for capturing flowers in A MAN WHO TAKES PICTURES OF FLOWERS. Kim finds meaning and happiness in reflecting on his body of work.

films.name: Chardak
films.description: A man named Miloš runs from danger in Ottoman-occupied Serbia in CHARDAK. A woman named Sara protects him. Their true identities and reality are tested.

films.name: Listen
films.description: As his mother slips away into dementia, an Alaskan sound recordist listens for what remains in LISTEN.

films.name: Reversal
films.description: REVERSAL shifts perspective endlessly. As the world folds and unfolds, collapses and re-forms, contracts and expands, lightens and darkens, breathes and expires, Reversal offers a shimmering mirage of what makes life worth living: the ecstasy of longing and desire, our connection to each other, the natural world, and loving gaze.

films.name: Yonsei
films.description: Rachel sets out to adapt her Japanese American mother’s 1980s Hollywood acting struggles into a film she’ll star in, in YONSEI. As she uncovers her grandmother’s WWII incarceration camp love story and unspoken family history, she becomes conflicted about whether she’s honoring the women in her life or exploiting them.

films.name: Rehearsals for a Revolution
films.description: Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story of resistance through five portraits of relatives and mentors in REHEARSALS FOR A REVOLUTION. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protest footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history, piecing together a portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution. A Sony Pictures Classics release

films.name: Reservation Redemption
films.description: RESERVATION REDEMPTION tells the powerful story of Chief Marchand Rice, a man who journeyed from a life sentence for murder to becoming a voice of hope, healing, and transformation. Raised on the Yakama Reservation, Chief’s early life was marked by struggle, loss, and a cycle of self-destruction, leading to his incarceration. Co-directors Brenda Fisher and Blake Pickens in attendance.

HEYSEL 85 follows the mayor’s daughter and an Italian journalist as they are drawn into the heart of the tragedy, caught between professional duty, family loyalty, and moral responsibility.

films.name: Faust
films.description: FAUST follows a pious alchemist, despairing as plague rages through the village. His prayers unanswered, he turns from God and summons the demon Mephisto, who grants him healing powers for one day. When the gift backfires, Faust hies back to his garret, where Mephisto waits with even sweeter enticements.

films.name: 14th
films.description: Written in the wreckage of the Civil War, the 14th Amendment was meant to close the door on the hierarchy of human worth. Instead, it has become the subject of a permanent argument. Ava DuVernay’s 14TH pulls this constitutional fight out of the footnotes and into the present, chronicling the vicious battle over the amendment that has raged for over 150 years. A Netflix Release

events.name: Who Likes Short Shorts (Short Filmmaker Panel)
events.description: Short filmmakers discuss their films in the 2026 Santa Fe International Film Festival.

films.name: Fork in the Road
films.description: FORK IN THE ROAD follows small farmers, visionary chefs, and innovators working to heal the land, improve our food systems, and transition toward a regenerative future for both people and the planet. The inspiring documentary travels from Alaska’s kelp farms to Kentucky dairies and Bronx urban gardens, spotlighting the farmers and food innovators reshaping our broken food system. Co-director Vivian Sorenson in attendance.

films.name: Banana
films.description: When mukbang fame thrusts her into the spotlight, Dizzy, an insecure Korean-American woman, must untangle her fractured identity and self-sabotage before her family decides to disown her… again, in BANANA (Episodes 1 & 2).

films.name: Matched
films.description: Ex-playwright turned elite matchmaker Diana is plagued by medical bills and on the brink of losing her job in MATCHED. Desperate, she convinces her talented, out-of-work actor friend to play the role of a “dream date” for her wealthy client-from-hell. At the breakneck speed of a farce, the pair navigate the date’s debacles and ultimately decide to expand the business.

events.name: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York

films.name: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
films.description: In THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK, Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family. A Sony Pictures Classics release

films.name: La Bola Negra
films.description: At the cusp of the Spanish Civil War, LA BOLA NEGRA follows a young man who confronts his ideology and sexuality as he is conscripted into the fascist army, where he becomes fascinated by a prisoner of war. Another young man in pre-dictatorship Spain finds himself blackballed from his father’s prestigious social club due to rumours about his sexuality. Starring Guitarricadelafuente, Miguel Bernardeau, Carlos González,Milo Quifes, with special appearances by Penélope Cruz and Glenn Close. Spain's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Netflix release

films.name: Foxy Brown
films.description: After her brother betrays her, FOXY BROWN follows a woman who goes undercover as a prostitute in order to find the gangsters who killed her boyfriend, and get revenge.

films.name: Fatherland
films.description: At the height of the Cold War, writer Thomas Mann and his daughter, actress, writer, and rally driver Erika (Sandra Huller), embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a divided Germany in ruins, traveling from the Allied-occupied city of Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar in FATHERLAND. Poland's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Mubi release

films.name: One Last Order
films.description: At Mac’s Drive-Thru in Gainesville, Florida, an ordinary day is about to become unforgettable. After 37 years of serving the community with a smile, Sighle Williams, the beloved, quick-witted voice who remembers your order before you do, is working her final shift in ONE LAST ORDER.

films.name: Sawyer Avenue, Sunday Afternoon
films.description: When masked and nameless US Border Patrol agents abduct a man from a residential street in Chicago's Albany Park neighborhood without a warrant, his neighbors attempt to obstruct the vehicle carrying him from leaving their block in SAWYER AVENUE, SUNDAY AFTERNOON.

films.name: Teaching America
films.description: TEACHING AMERICA explores the battle over the teaching of African-American history and studies from inside the classroom. It focuses on the transformative journeys of the Arkansas teachers, students, and families who are part of the very first inaugural classes of students taking Advanced Placement African-American Studies nationwide.

films.name: Water Cooler
films.description: The Trump administration has turned immigration courts into deportation traps. As ICE agents wait to arrest their targets outside of courtrooms, their banal conversations clash with the severity of their actions in WATER COOLER.

films.name: We're Fine
films.description: Two years into the war, Ukrainian artists unite at Burning Man to build a massive sculpture from war-scarred road signs in WE’RE FINE. As strangers become family, their creation reveals the hidden pain beneath survival, turning trauma into art and rubble into a powerful symbol of resilience, truth, and unity.

events.name: You made a film, what's next? (Panel)
events.description: Industry insiders discuss the next steps on how to market and edit a film with Kate McQuerrey(Buff, No Country for Old Men, Burn After Reading), Christina Campagnola (Circle Collective), Kyle Greenberg (Utopia), Sandrine Cassidy (USC)

films.name: A Talent for Murder
films.description: The smoldering chamber thriller, A TALENT FOR MURDER, from Anton Corbijn (Control) stars Academy Award winner Helen Mirren and Alden Ehrenreich (Weapons) as opponents in a strange confrontation between a youthful literary agent and “The Talented Mr. Ripley” author Patricia Highsmith. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: Lady
films.description: In LADY, A determined taxi driver in Lagos forms an unexpected bond with a group of free-spirited women, leading her into a world of friendship and self-discovery despite the risks along the way. As Lady becomes entangled in their world, the nights grow more dangerous, and the city presses harder against old wounds she’s never confronted.

events.name: Coffee Chat with Howard Korder
events.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning screenwriter and playwright Howard Korder is also an American television producer. He won two Primetime Emmy Awards and served as a writer and executive producer on Boardwalk Empire. Moderated by William DeBuys.

films.name: Blood Lines
films.description: BLOOD LINES is a lesbian romance wrapped up in a celebration of Métis culture and centers around an upcoming Métis Day festival. Storyteller and store clerk Beatrice (Dana Solomon) is completely taken by a new woman who arrives in her Métis community looking to find her biological family. Beatrice decides to help Chani (Derica Lyn Lafrance) in order to spend more time with her. Director Gail Maurice in attendance.

films.name: Possible Love
films.description: For Ho-seok and Mi-ok hope to move on from the trauma caused by the disastrous outcome of a labour dispute in POSSIBLE LOVE. When they are approached by a young, ambitious documentary filmmaker Ye-ji to take part in her latest project, they become intimately intertwined with her and her business-mogul husband, Sang-woo. South Korea's submission to the 2027 Academy Award®. A Netflix release

films.name: I Play Rocky
films.description:
I PLAY ROCKY is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn’t just meant to write Rocky; he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie. An Amazon MGM release

Introduction by Editor Sam Seig

films.name: Give Me The Ball!
films.description: We remember Billie Jean King’s infamous impact on tennis and gender equality, but in GIVE ME THE BALL!, we come to understand the sacrifices she was forced to make behind the scenes. Through rarely seen archival material and powerfully honest interviews with King, her story of selflessness, struggle, and triumph shines an unforgettable light on the groundbreaker. Co-director Elizabeth Wolff in attendance.

films.name: Tender Loving Care
films.description: As the demands of work and family begin to converge, a social worker(Kate O’Flynn) and those closest to her discover the strength found in compassion, community, and one another. Set in post-Brexit England, the final film by Mike Leigh, TENDER LOVING CARE is a richly observed portrait of resilience, humor, and the enduring power of human connection. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: Backstage
films.description: BACKSTAGE follows a young actor’s breakthrough role becomes a dangerous game of desire and control when his ruthless director takes a personal interest in him.

films.name: Last Resort
films.description: Terminally ill Paul Siegert travels to a secluded Swiss mountain resort for an assisted suicide. LAST RESORT tells of how a chance encounter with another guest, also scheduled to die the next day, turns Paul’s final night into a night of reckless connection, ultimately leading him to question his plan.

films.name: The Decision Making Center
films.description: After Martin, a former therapist and the top employee at the Decision Making Center, gets tasked with training a new AI, he must teach the AI (Theo) to have empathy and help humans navigate challenging decisions in THE DECISION MAKING CENTER.

films.name: Vaterland or a Bule Named Yanto
films.description: When German-Indonesian Yanto visits his younger sister in Yogyakarta, he expects a simple reunion, until he realises she belongs more effortlessly than he ever has. As envy and dissonance between siblings surface, Yanto's journey becomes a bittersweet exploration of mixed-race identity in VATERLAND OR A BLUE NAME YANTO.

films.name: Look Back
films.description: From director Hirokazu Kore-eda(Shoplifters, SFiFF 2017) LOOK BACK follows Fujina, precocious and popular; she’s happy hanging with friends and drawing weekly strips for her grade school publication. One day she meets her match in Kyomoto, a homeschooled student with a dazzling technique. Soon, the two are close collaborators, creating manga together and enjoying great success. Everything is wonderful until one day, Kyomoto breaks the partnership. A GKIDS Films Release

films.name: Only What We Carry
films.description: Long-buried secrets and emerging romances bubble up and boil over between a dancer, her sister, her former choreographer, and his visiting friend in ONLY WHAT WE CARRY, an improvisational drama shot in six days on the Normandy coast. Starring Simon Pegg, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Quentin Tarantino, Liam Hellmann, and Lizzy McAlpine.

events.name: Visionary Award Zahn McClarnon
events.description: The Santa Fe International Film Festival will present its Visionary Award to distinguished actor Zahn McClarnon. Followed by a discussion with Chris Eyre executive producer of DARK WINDS. Following the dicussion, SFiFF will screen McClarnon's directoral debut Dark Winds season 4, episode 2, Bikéé' Doo Éédahooziideegóó. (Toward Their Unknown Paths) McClarnon is most recently known for his leading role as Lieutenant Joe Leaphorn in the AMC series Dark Winds executive produced by George R.R. Martin and the late Robert Redford. DARK WINDS follows two Navajo police officers in the 1970s as they investigate numerous seemingly unrelated crimes and is set in the American Southwest and shot in Santa Fe.

films.name: Dark Winds
films.description: In DARK WINDS (Season 4 Episode 2), Leaphorn, Chee, and Manuelito uncover new clues to the missing girl's whereabouts in the wake of a deadly shooting. Zahn McClarnon's directoral debut.

films.name: Visionary Award Zahn McClarnon
films.description: The Santa Fe International Film Festival will present its Visionary Award to distinguished actor Zahn McClarnon. Followed by a discussion with Chris Eyre executive producer of DARK WINDS. Following the dicussion, SFiFF will screen McClarnon's directoral debut Dark Winds season 4, episode 2, Bikéé' Doo Éédahooziideegóó. (Toward Their Unknown Paths) McClarnon is most recently known for his leading role as Lieutenant Joe Leaphorn in the AMC series Dark Winds executive produced by George R.R. Martin and the late Robert Redford. DARK WINDS follows two Navajo police officers in the 1970s as they investigate numerous seemingly unrelated crimes and is set in the American Southwest and shot in Santa Fe.

films.name: Wild Horse Nine
films.description: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways. A Searchlight Pictures Release

films.name: Elephants in the Fog
films.description: ELEPHANTS IN THE FOG follows a Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest inhabited by wild elephants. Pirati, the matriarch of a Kinnar community, dreams of escaping to live with the man she loves. But when one of her daughters goes missing, she must investigate and choose between her desire for freedom and her responsibilities to her community. Nepal's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®

films.name: Sender
films.description: After receiving a series of unnervingly personal packages she never ordered, a woman (Britt Lower), newly sober and starting over, spirals into paranoia, convinced someone is watching her. As the online retailer denies responsibility, her search for the anonymous sender sends her down a dangerous rabbit hole. SENDER is a tense psychological descent into surveillance, recovery, and self-doubt. Featuring Rhea Seehorn and Jamie Lee Curtis.

films.name: Radon's Daughters
films.description: RADON’S DAUGHTERS tells the fate of two New Mexican families that collide at a toxic Día de los Muertos celebration in a Uranium-tainted church. After her mother mysteriously vanished from the Uranium mines feeding the nearby government lab, Nita Iglesias (Morningstar Angeline) is desperate for one more reunion as Día de los Muertos approaches, drawing the dead back home. Director Siena Sofia Bergt in attendance.

films.name: Campeón Gabacho (Gringo Champion)
films.description: A determined Mexican migrant boxes his way through challenges and discrimination in America, using his fighting spirit and optimism to rise above adversity and find unexpected success in Campeón Gabacho (Gringo Champion).

films.name: Empty Lands
films.description: When a soldier and his wife move into a state-subsidized house, EMPTY LANDS tells the mystery of a missing daughter from the family who once lived there disturbs their domestic life

films.name: Headphones
films.description: While listening to his uncle’s old Walkman, a lovelorn young man working the late shift at a dead-end fast-food joint alongside his crush hears a mysterious voice through the headphones, whispering exactly what he must do to keep her alive in HEADPHONES.

films.name: In The Weeds
films.description: An obsessive husband discovers an unkillable weed that begins to threaten his suburban and so-called "perfect life" in IN THE WEEDS.

films.name: Prime
films.description: A trauma victim joins a utopian farming community only to find she's bitten off more than she can chew in PRIME.

films.name: Time's Up, I'm Afraid
films.description: During a routine session in TIME'S UP, I'M AFRAID, a hypnotherapist discovers she may be the one who has been hypnotised.

films.name: Climate Control
films.description: CLIMATE CONTROL follows a director making a documentary about fossil fuel extraction consistently subverted by an agent that wants to tell a generic love story.

films.name: Galicia!
films.description: GALICIA! is a found-footage documentary following Anna Maguire and Kyle Greenberg through their home videos as they visit their friends at a winery in rural Spain. What starts as a couple’s travelogue devolves into a heightened vision of the end of days, inadvertently recording the unimaginable and leading us to question the fragility of humanity and its power to endure. Co-Directors Anna Maguire and Kyle Greenberg in attenance.

films.name: Our Effed Up World
films.description: Sheri thought her biggest problem in life was dealing with the recent loss of her beloved grandma. But when a mysterious entity crash-lands in the woods, only she and her group of shitkicker friends are what stands in the way of an insatiable, intergalactic hunger in OUR EFFED UP WORLD.

events.name: Filmmaker Welcome Party
events.description: This is a party to celebrate all of the filmmakers joining SFiFF and welcome them to Santa Fe at the apropriately named Lady Duff's. 21+

films.name: 14th
films.description: Written in the wreckage of the Civil War, the 14th Amendment was meant to close the door on the hierarchy of human worth. Instead, it has become the subject of a permanent argument. Ava DuVernay’s 14TH pulls this constitutional fight out of the footnotes and into the present, chronicling the vicious battle over the amendment that has raged for over 150 years. A Netflix Release

events.name: Animated Films for Kids
events.description: Free Screening

films.name: ChikaBOOM!
films.description: CHIKABOOM! follows Chika Batstone, an aspiring young magician whose curiosity accidentally unleashes Kaboom, a chaotic magical creature, into the heart of New York City. With her world-famous magician father, The Amazin’ Arnie, performing nearby, Chika must contain the mayhem before it’s too late.

films.name: Firefly
films.description: FIREFLY is a story about forest dwellers and glittering fireflies. They bring light into the darkness of night, helping lost daytime insects.

films.name: Flink's Pigeon Problems
films.description: An adorable creature leaves no stone unturned trying to rescue his kingdom's pigeons in FLINK'S PIGEON PROBLEMS.

films.name: Remember The Rats
films.description: In 1920s Buenos Aires, a city shaped by European immigration, a family of rats peacefully roams Plaza de Mayo, sustained by a kind-hearted baker who shares his empanadas with them. However, the governor, repulsed by the rodents, travels to Paris and discovers skilled hunting pigeons in REMEMBER THE RATS.

films.name: Rock Shanty
films.description: ROCK SHANTY follows the whimsical, if not wacky tale of Sorbet the Siren and her attempts to lure in the fisherman, Flounder to eat for her dinner using her feminine charms and magical singing voice. Only to be thwarted by Flounders son Gelato in a ridiculous but clever fashion as he counters her magic with an epic guitar solo. Luring his dad back in towards a back and forth battle of music and wit.

films.name: The Hat
films.description: When a witch's hat is taken by a sudden storm, she must come to terms with her new look in THE HAT.

films.name: Till Death Does His Part
films.description: The dark comedy, TILL DEATH DOES HIS PART, tells the story of the Grim Reaper taking his son to "Take Your Kid To Work Day", demonstrating to his son what he does every day.

films.name: Waiting for the green
films.description: WAITING FOR THE GREEN is a story about a chance meeting, freedom that trunks reach for, and love that sometimes only requires a short stop.

films.name: Gentle Monster
films.description: GENTLE MONSTER follows Lucy(Léa Seydoux), a concert pianist, who has just relocated her family to a country house in the hope of easing her husband’s severe burnout. Before they can settle in, an early morning police visit tears their world apart. Lucy must face the situation alone, trapped between the man she loves and the fear of what he may have done. A Netflix release

events.name: The Art of Editing
events.description: The Art of Editing with Katie McQuerrey (No Country for Old Men, Inside Llewyn Davis), Sam Seig (I Play Rocky), and Alexandria Bombach (On Her Shoulders) moderated by Hunter Robert Baker.

films.name: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing
films.description: SUMO: SPIRIT WEIGHS NOTHING grants rare inside access to Japan’s hidden world of sumo. Over a turbulent year, wrestlers at every stage of their career fight to endure, revealing that true strength is measured not in flesh, but in spirit.

films.name: Daughters of the Forest
films.description: DAUGHTERS OF THE FOREST takes place deep in Mexico’s forests, where two Indigenous mycologists embark on an unexpected, sometimes speculative exploration of the realities of two Indigenous communities and the fungi in the forests of Mexico, inviting them to reconsider the perceptions and experiences of both the human and non-human inhabitants of our world.

events.description:

films.name: Tender Loving Care
films.description: As the demands of work and family begin to converge, a social worker(Kate O’Flynn) and those closest to her discover the strength found in compassion, community, and one another. Set in post-Brexit England, the final film by Mike Leigh, TENDER LOVING CARE is a richly observed portrait of resilience, humor, and the enduring power of human connection. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: Artificial Love
films.description: A lonely man finds companionship in ChatGPT, leading to an unconventional romance that challenges the boundaries of love and what it means to be human in ARTIFICIAL LOVE.

films.name: Dad
films.description: When Dr. Mark Walter Miller chooses a medically assisted death following a terminal cancer diagnosis, his filmmaker son begins documenting their final months together. An intimate portrait of a father and son exploring autonomy, dignity, and the beauty of ordinary life in the shadow of death unfolds in DAD.

films.name: Purely Patricia
films.description: PURELY PATRICIA follows New York style icon Patricia Fox, a woman who treats every day as an occasion to dress up. Known for her exuberant fashion and joyful presence, Patricia embodies a life lived in color and self-expression. But beneath the twirls and textures lies a quieter reckoning with time.

films.name: Spheres
films.description: SPHERES follows a filmmaker who documents the creation of memorial sculptures made from cremated remains. As swirling inks collide and expand like distant galaxies, a meditation emerges on grief, memory, and the strange human desire to transform loss into something beautiful.

films.name: Still Standing
films.description: After the Los Angeles wildfires, thousands of homes are left standing, yet contaminated with toxic ash. Residents face an impossible choice: risk their health to return home? Shot from the inside of toxic homes on 16mm, STILL STANDING considers what it means to survive one disaster only to face another.

films.name: The Revolution Against Death
films.description: THE REVOLUTION AGAINST DEATH is a poem by director Joshua Lincoln Oppenheimer's about fears of mortality, capitalism, desperate denial, and our universal longing for communion and love.

events.name: Your Name in Lights (Actor's Panel)
events.description: Working actors share the mindset shifts, practical strategies, and daily routines with Cassidy Freeman(#Undertheinfluence, The Righteous Gemstones), Natalie Benally (Dark Winds) and David Magidoff( #Undertheinfluence, Dexter: Resurrection)

films.name: Ink
films.description: From Academy Award-winning director Danny Boyle INK follows the life of Rupert Murdoch(Guy Pierce) and his group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news, one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today. A Netflix release

films.name: Minotaur
films.description: MINOTAUR takes place in Russia, 2022. When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures and an increasingly unstable world, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence. France's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Mubi release

films.name: Major Barbara
films.description: Based on the Tony-nominated play by George Bernard Shaw, MAJOR BARBARA tells the story of a wildly idealistic young woman, Barbara Undershaft (Sara Haider), who helps the poor as a Salvation Army Major at an anything-goes homeless shelter. She's a stalwart devotee to the cause and has visions for the place - although her ambitions are often squashed by a lack of funding. Director Jay Craven and star Tantoo Cardinal in attendance.

events.name: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff

films.name: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
films.description: CARL SAGAN: WE ARE MADE OF STAR STUFF is an intimate portrait of the visionary astronomer, author, and television star whose groundbreaking ideas transformed our understanding of the cosmos and human existence. With unprecedented access to his extensive personal archive, the film explores Sagan’s cosmic love story with partner Ann Druyan and his evolution as a father, husband, and scientist. A National Geographic Documentary Films release

films.name: La Gradiva
films.description: A group of French high school students travel to Naples on a school trip to discover the ruins of Pompeii and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in LA GRADIVA. There, they are drawn into a dizzying descent. One by one, they are swept up in desire and anger until they surrender to them completely. Winner of the Grand Prize (Ami Paris Grand Prize) at the Cannes Film Festival Critics' Week.

events.name: Distribution Panel
events.description: Hear from distribution experts like Jim Brunzell (Dark Star Pictures), Danielle McCarthy-Boles (Magnolia Pictures), Alexandra Fredricks (Oscilloscope), and Max Geschwind(CAA Finance).

events.name: Indigenous Shorts 1
events.description: Institute of American Indian Arts and Cherokee Film

films.name: Ghost Lake
films.description: After the overdose death of a teen, an Ojibway tracker exposes a drug smuggling ring, forcing him to confront corrupt leadership and broken systems in GHOST LAKE.

films.name: Shadow in the Desert
films.description: After a reckless, drug-fueled robbery on the Navajo reservation, a young woman escapes with stolen goods she doesn’t realize are carrying a corrupting influence IN SHADOW IN THE DESERT. She’s driven toward a brutal confrontation with something far more dangerous than she ever expected, and her own addiction.

films.name: Sons Are Not Earthbound
films.description: At a grief camp in Hawaiʻi, SONS ARE NOT EARTHBOUND is about a young boy who strives to trap the endangered ʻiʻiwi bird, his late mother’s spirit animal, as he navigates the complexities of loss in a quest for closure, learning to carry forward what he fears losing most.

films.name: Taxi the Empties
films.description: Madden is given one day to find work or face eviction from his father’s home on the rez. TAXI THE EMPTIES follows a trip across the rez with empties to buy phone credit, becoming a raw journey through community, conflict, and consequence, testing his survival, character, and sense of connection.

films.name: Two Old Women
films.description: In a striking reimagining of Velma Wallis’ novel, TWO OLD WOMEN, two elderly women, Sa' and Ch'idzigyaak, in 1400's Alaska, are abandoned by their band in a desperate bid for survival as a brutal winter looms. They must draw on their traditional knowledge and summon unwavering determination to survive.

films.name: A Little Death
films.description: Death’s patience is tested when his sweet and gentle apprentice appears incapable of the task, leading him to seek professional help from the most unlikely of places. A LITTLE DEATH is based on the graphic novel "Notes on a Case of Melancholia, Or: A Little Death" by Nicholas Gurewitch.

films.name: Acid City
films.description: ACID CITY is a documentary about a fictional city in the middle of a great acidic ocean. It follows a film crew over the course of one day as they interview and document what life is like in the isolated city, composed of real interviews conducted across NYC.

films.name: Addicted To It
films.description: ADDICTED TO IT follows Dace, who attempts the impossible: a peaceful park walk without his phone. But his device, Phoney Bunny, springs to life and chases him like a clingy ex. As Dace recruits fellow screen junkies to unplug, one question remains: can you survive 5–10 minutes without your phone?

films.name: Beyond Measure
films.description: BEYOND MEASURE follows a man who discovers he is physically shrinking, forcing him and his wife to navigate life’s ups and downs with increasing creativity and adaptability as his stature diminishes.

films.name: Hope is Lost
films.description: Ten days before 2000, single mother Hope arrives in London with her infants, fleeing a haunted past. A stranger offers refuge, but his motives prove chilling. To save her children from a threat worse than Y2K, Hope races against time, willing to sacrifice everything in HOPE IS LOST.

films.name: In the Beginning
films.description: IN THE BEGINNING follows three surreal tales, exploring humanity's relationship with animals: a lunar probe's tardigrade cargo, medieval myths about exotic birds, and Hong Kong's pandemic-driven hamster crisis.

films.name: Pigeons
films.description: In a world that keeps changing, PIGEONS follows a carrier pigeon who loses his job the day a telephone is installed in his owner’s home. Searching for food, shelter, and purpose, the film explores freedom, progress, and what gets lost along the way.

films.name: The Flowers of Malva
films.description: In a small village in the Ukrainian countryside, Nina, a grandmother deeply attached to her land, welcomes her granddaughter Yana for a holiday visit. Nina must hide the war that is ravaging the country from her granddaughter by creating an imaginary world where everything is fine in THE FLOWERS OF MALVA.

films.name: Trading Cards
films.description: TRADING CARDS is a dark fantasy animated film about the weight of living with Obsessive-compulsive disorder.

events.name: The Director's Chair
events.description: Director's with feature films in the festival their process.

films.name: Elsinore
films.description: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson (Andrew Scott), a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph in ELSINORE. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him. A Focus Features release

events.name: Sorrel Sky Reception
events.description: Passholder Only event, celebrate the Santa Fe International Film Festival and enjoy the beautiful art of David Yarrow and others at Sorrel Sky with refreshments and light bites.

events.name: Coffee Chat with Laura Karpman
events.description: Oscar nominated, Emmy award winning composer, Laura Karpman, known for her work on American Fiction, Lovecraft Country, and Why We Hate will discuss her work on the 2026 SFiFF official selections Give Me the Ball!, Cosmic Symphony, and Buried Under Years of Dust.

films.name: La Bola Negra
films.description: At the cusp of the Spanish Civil War, LA BOLA NEGRA follows a young man who confronts his ideology and sexuality as he is conscripted into the fascist army, where he becomes fascinated by a prisoner of war. Another young man in pre-dictatorship Spain finds himself blackballed from his father’s prestigious social club due to rumours about his sexuality. Starring Guitarricadelafuente, Miguel Bernardeau, Carlos González,Milo Quifes, with special appearances by Penélope Cruz and Glenn Close. Spain's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Netflix release

films.name: Nuisance Bear
films.description: NUISANCE BEAR immerses viewers in the experience of a polar bear forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as climate change delays the freeze and pushes bears closer to human settlements. When a sacred predator is branded a “nuisance,” it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape. Winner of the Grand Jury Prize for Documentary at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

films.name: All of a Sudden
films.description: ALL OF A SUDDEN tells the story of Marie-Lou (Virginie Efira), a director of a care facility for the elderly, who strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari (Tao Okamoto), a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. Japan's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A NEON release

films.name: Smudge The Blades
films.description: SMUDGE THE BLADES is a coming-of-age hockey film that follows the TREATY 6 BLADES, a U18 team from a small reserve outside of Edmonton, forced to salvage their final year of hockey in the rough-and-tumble Country League of northern Alberta. Actor Jana Schmieding in attendance. Winner of the Best Canadian Discovery Award from the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival

films.name: Homebody
films.description: Facing eviction after her mother’s death, a young artist searches for creative ways to defend her right to stay in her Brooklyn apartment in HOMEBODY.

films.name: Inside These Walls
films.description: INSIDE THESE WALLS follows an incarcerated father reunites with his wife and daughter for twenty-four hours and attempts to navigate an uncertain future. How does a family stay together when they only have a single day to try?

films.name: Kavi
films.description: Amid the relentless chaos of London’s delivery culture, Kavi, a Sri Lankan immigrant, struggles to find his place in the city’s unforgiving rhythm in KAVI. When a chance encounter introduces him to Leela, a fellow Sri Lankan immigrant, Kavi glimpses an opportunity to finally form a meaningful connection.

films.name: No Cowboys
films.description: Geronimo, a ranch hand in recovery, has turned a wild horse into a specialty animal that bows only to him. When a rising movie star arrives at the failing ranch wanting Tondo, everything he has steadied starts to give in NO COWBOYS.

films.name: Wedding Flowers
films.description: Lily returns to her childhood home for her older brother Vinh’s Vietnamese-American wedding. As tensions rise and the celebration threatens to fall apart, Lily and her alcoholic mother confront the distance between them and how that resistance slowly shifts toward an uneasy understanding in WEDDING FLOWERS.

films.name: Why I Am an Anarchist
films.description: In the wealthy suburbs of Arizona, an animal-rights extremist has her ideology thrown into a tailspin when she meets an unhoused teenager in the desert behind her school in WHY I AM AN ANARCHIST.

films.name: Lifetime Achievement Award Pam Grier
films.description: The prestigious Lifetime Achievement Award to acclaimed actress, singer, and activist Pam Grier followed by a discussion moderated by screenwriter and SFiFF advisory board member Kirk Ellis (Franklin, John Adams). A powerhouse of talent and a pioneer for African American representation in Hollywood, Grier has captivated audiences for more than four decades. She is perhaps best known for her performances as the title character in Jack Hill’s exploitation action film, Foxy Brown (1974) where Grier’s powerful and triumphant physical presence offset subversive sex appeal, setting her apart from other women actors at the time. Nearly three decades later, she played the title character in Quentin Tarantino's Jackie Brown (1997), for which she earned a Golden Globe nomination for Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture.

films.name: The Liberation
films.description: Rita (Carrie Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (Lily James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. When her daughters Ella (Bella Ramsey) and Jo (Odessa Young) arrive unexpectedly, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her. A Bleecker Street release

films.name: Buff
films.description: After being released from jail for climate activism, a woman encounters an abused rodeo Buffalo for which she will trek the American Southwest in an attempt to free it and herself in BUFF.

films.name: Cannibal Oasis
films.description: CANNIBAL OASIS shows the bizarre life cycle of the New Mexico spadefoot toad, a creature with one of the most dramatic and violent starts to life of any animal. They must rapidly transform from egg to land-dwelling frog before the puddle they were born in evaporates in only two weeks.

films.name: Dancers at the Crossroads
films.description: DANCERS AT THE CROSSROADS is the story of dance in New Mexico, one of survival after centuries of brutal Spanish and American colonization. It takes an intimate look at dancers from the Rio Grande region who share their generational traditions of Indigenous Hoop Dance, Flamenco, Folklórico, and Breaking.

films.name: In Between
films.description: In IN BETWEEN, a young boy leads his mother on a journey to a home where he believes he lived a previous life. His arrival unearths deep-seated emotions in the family of a daughter missing the past seven years.

films.name: La Carne Asada
films.description: Tensions rise at a family cookout in LA CARNE ASADA. Tony, the family loudmouth, tries to cheer up his heartbroken nephew, Danny. Mari tries to gain her mother-in-law’s respect. Sarah makes her way with her white boyfriend, Brian, to meet the family, setting the stage for a memorable cookout.

films.name: The Bookstore
films.description: Ten-year-old Leo spends his afternoons in a neighborhood bookstore run by his mother, Maria, a trusted pillar of their community. When Maria is taken by masked federal agents, Leo is left to confront a reality that contradicts everything he’s been taught about fairness, safety, and the law in THE BOOKSTORE.

films.name: Borderline
films.description: A Norwegian customs officer, a Finnish poacher, and a mysterious Swedish woman meet at the border between their homelands, becoming entangled in a conflict over laws, language, and prejudice. Confronted with their own secrets, they must find an unconventional solution in BORDERLINE.

films.name: Homebodies
films.description: In a near future where it literally costs money to leave the house, HOMEBODIES follows a burnt-out woman who risks fraud when she pays her live-in boyfriend's 'exit toll' to get some alone time.

films.name: Nuns With Guns
films.description: NUNS WITH GUNS follows three devout nuns who discover their beloved church and only home is being foreclosed due to financial mismanagement. Desperate to save it, the fierce Mother Joan, dutiful Sister Mary, and reckless Sister Abigail stage an ill-conceived bank robbery that spirals into chaos, comedy, and unexpected success.

films.name: OMG
films.description: As the world collapses under violence, hypocrisy, and climate anxiety, Diana, a 40-year-old atheist, is unexpectedly chosen by God to carry His new plan to save humanity in OMG. The Angel Gabriel visits her to announce that she is pregnant with the Second Son of God.

films.name: The Burden of Manhood
films.description: In THE BURDEN OF MANHOOD, Jørn-Gunnar identifies as a cat, despite being an adult man, because he feels insufficient as a man. His girlfriend, Stella, is fed up and takes him to the vet to break up with him. Afraid of getting cancelled, the vet gives him an examination.

films.name: The Cranberry Effect
films.description: A sharp detective investigates a grisly diner massacre, but her mind is consumed by a roasted chicken recipe that’s driving her mad. THE CRANBERRY EFFECT is a surreal and darkly comedic noir where bullets fly, bodies drop, and the real mystery... is simmering in the kitchen.

films.name: The Oracle
films.description: THE ORACLE follows a con artist patient who convinces his psychiatrist to put him under hypnosis; a message from the doctor's long-dead twin emerges. Is this the perfect con? Or proof that reality is far stranger than the doctor would like to admit?

films.name: The Waddles
films.description: A photo plunges Joy into despair in THE WADDLES. Max convinces her to join him in getting a cosmetic procedure and then hiding away in Palm Springs over the holidays to convalesce.

films.name: Glitched
films.description: GLITCHED is about two lonely hearts seeking comfort in the arms of a robot supplied by a dating app called AmoreAi. Things get complicated when emotions, friends, and a toxic ex get involved, but will they find what they are looking for before their time is up?

films.name: Forcefield of Love
films.description: Doris and Dan’s lives are full of dancing, sex, and other intimate pleasures as they defy traditional expectations of how we can embrace life, death, and aging in A FORCEFIELD OF LOVE.

films.name: Send Nudes
films.description: Two young lovers in a long-distance relationship at the end of the 16th century send each other love letters with a carrier pigeon. Since her parents won’t allow them to meet in person, they can’t fulfill their fantasies together in SEND NUDES.

films.name: Three
films.description: When a young man is invited into the home of an older couple late at night, a tantalising game of control and chemistry begins. THREE is a provocative and darkly funny short exploring themes of sex, power, and privilege.

films.name: Achiever
films.description: When Alexa finds she can no longer orgasm due to her new antidepressant prescription, she embarks on a desperate journey to get off by any means possible, only to find herself “getting close” through an unexpected connection in ACHIEVER.

films.name: The Dream is a Snail
films.description: THE DREAM IS A SNAIL focuses on a young artist’s addiction to snails after landing a bizarre gig: serving as a motionless human racetrack for snails during a rejuvenation therapy workshop for seniors.

films.name: Blood Lines
films.description: BLOOD LINES is a lesbian romance wrapped up in a celebration of Métis culture and centers around an upcoming Métis Day festival. Storyteller and store clerk Beatrice (Dana Solomon) is completely taken by a new woman who arrives in her Métis community looking to find her biological family. Beatrice decides to help Chani (Derica Lyn Lafrance) in order to spend more time with her. Director Gail Maurice in attendance.

films.name: Paradise
films.description: In the wake of his father’s disappearance at sea, Kojo, a young Ghanaian is drawn into a world of deception while Tony discovers his mother’s online relationship with a sailor may hold the key to finding the father he’s never met. Determined to find answers, Tony travels to Ghana, crossing paths with Kojo in a journey that will change their lives.

events.name: VIP Party
events.description: Celebrate like VIP at Chomp Food Hall while dancing the night away with DJ Dynamite Sol. 21+

films.name: Farm to Fashion
films.description: Through the people who shape wool’s journey from farm to fabric, the film explores agriculture, craftsmanship, and a more thoughtful relationship with fashion. As global supply chains and overconsumption reshape the industry, FARM TO FASHION invites audiences to reconsider where their clothing comes from and at what cost.

films.name: Gladice
films.description: Drawing from 14 years of stunning footage, GLADICE is a fairytale documentary about a glacier who develops a parasocial relationship with an arctic wildlife photographer as she grapples with the horrific suspicion that she might be dying at the hands of climate change.

films.name: The Coral Rescuers
films.description: It’s all hands on deck to rescue Florida’s last remaining wild corals in THE CORAL RESCUERS. Activists and scientists unite to fight against climate change and its ongoing destruction.

events.name: Roadmap Writers Screenwriting Workshop
events.description: Take a look at any roadmap: There are a plethora of ways to get from point A to point B. Some routes require more luck than others; some are roads less traveled; while still others are riddled with detours... Breaking into and sustaining a career in the screenwriting business is hard – sometimes it can feel nearly impossible. Enter Roadmap Writers, a team of industry veterans dedicated to equipping screenwriters with the real-world tools and training needed to take their career to the next level.

films.name: Iron Boy
films.description: IRON BOY follows 10-year-old Christophe (Gary Clichy), who tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. Overcome by dizzy spells that disable him from doing most things, Christophe must reinvent his life away from the farm by wearing an iron corset to keep himself upright. A Sony Pictures Classics release

films.name: Possible Love
films.description: For Ho-seok and Mi-ok hope to move on from the trauma caused by the disastrous outcome of a labour dispute in POSSIBLE LOVE. When they are approached by a young, ambitious documentary filmmaker Ye-ji to take part in her latest project, they become intimately intertwined with her and her business-mogul husband, Sang-woo. South Korea's submission to the 2027 Academy Award®. A Netflix release

films.name: Timber Lands
films.description: In the rugged Pacific Northwest, a generations-old feud between an Indigenous family and a powerful logging dynasty reignites, pulling a new generation into a war over blood, legacy, and the land they both call home. TIMBER LANDS confronts the complexity we’re often asked to simplify. Director Baylee Toney and actor Wes Studi in attendance.

films.name: Fatherland
films.description: At the height of the Cold War, writer Thomas Mann and his daughter, actress, writer, and rally driver Erika (Sandra Huller), embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a divided Germany in ruins, traveling from the Allied-occupied city of Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar in FATHERLAND. Poland's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®. A Mubi release

events.name: Red, Green or Xmas: New Mexico Film Salon
events.description: New Mexico filmmakers with films in the festival discuss created a film in the unique New Mexico scenery

films.name: La Tierra del Valor (The Home of the Brave)
films.description: This past summer, as ICE raids turned Los Angeles upside down, Nezza stepped out into Dodger Stadium on No Kings Day and sang the national anthem in Spanish. LA TIERRA DEL VALOR (THE HOME OF THE BRAVE) teaches everyone about bravery during a time of turmoil and hopelessness.

films.name: Room of the Absolute
films.description: Amid three years of relentless destruction to her homeland, Ukrainian painter Alla Hurenko offers a new perspective on daily life under war. Her canvas becomes a powerful act of resistance, a testament to perseverance, and a quiet rebellion against those determined to erase her in ROOM OF THE ABSOLUTE.

films.name: Testing Testing Sandi Bachom
films.description: An intrepid group of independent journalists tracks extremists in America in TESTING TESTING SANDI BACHOM. Sandi Bachom is among the most prolific, and by far the most unlikely. Now 82, her bid for redemption – for self and for country – has only just begun.

films.name: The Last Journey
films.description: THE LAST JOURNEY follows Jesse and Susanne, who face an impossible choice when Jesse is diagnosed with Lewy Body Dementia. Jesse decides to end his life by Voluntarily Stopping Eating and Drinking (VSED). They navigate the profound tenderness, conflict, and courage of loving and letting go on their own terms.

events.name: George R.R. Martin produced Heirs of the Perisphere

films.name: George R.R. Martin produced Heirs of the Perisphere
films.description: After centuries of silence, three animatronic robots named Howard the Hamster, Goonybird, and WoofWoof awaken to a world where humanity has vanished. Built to entertain and serve, HEIRS OF THE PERISPHERE sets the trio out across an unfamiliar landscape in search of the people who made them.

films.name: A Bit of Light
films.description: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, A BIT OF LIGHT follows a disillusioned Iranian doctor who loses faith in the future. Determined to end his life, he spends one final day visiting his siblings and mother to prepare them for his departure. Their compassion, care, and companionship slowly reconcile him with reality.

events.name: Indigenous Filmmaking Panel
events.description: Indigenous Filmmaking Panel moderated by Gary Farmer

events.name: Awards Ceremony
events.description: Join us to celebrate and announce the 2026 Award Winners of the festival. Following the ceremony enjoy light bites by Rowley's Farmhouse Ales.

films.name: Brian
films.description: BRIAN follows Brian: smart, funny, and deeply depressed. A disastrous drama club audition leads to a public meltdown, thus beginning Brian’s search for his new “thing.” With help from his therapist and the new kid, Justin, Brian launches his high-stakes campaign and sparks a messy, exquisitely awkward journey toward self-acceptance.

films.name: Seized
films.description: Balancing the absurdity of small-town politics with the gravity of a constitutional crisis, SEIZED, set in the small town of Marion, Kansas, is thrust into the international spotlight after a police raid on the Marion County Record and the death of its 98-year-old co-owner.

films.name: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing
films.description: SUMO: SPIRIT WEIGHS NOTHING grants rare inside access to Japan’s hidden world of sumo. Over a turbulent year, wrestlers at every stage of their career fight to endure, revealing that true strength is measured not in flesh, but in spirit.

films.name: Ink
films.description: From Academy Award-winning director Danny Boyle INK follows the life of Rupert Murdoch(Guy Pierce) and his group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news, one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today. A Netflix release

films.name: Everytime
films.description: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio takes a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap in EVERYTIME. Germany's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®

films.name: Madwoman's Game
films.description: Executive produced by Keanu Reeves, MADWOMAN'S GAME follows the coming-of-age story of Bianca Mitchell-Avila, a young Latina chess enthusiast from Albuquerque, New Mexico. As she explores life’s lessons through the lens of the game, she must ask herself: should she stay in her hometown or start somewhere new? She suspects the game may hold the answer, setting her off on a journey across the world. Bianca Mitchell-Avila in Attendance

events.name: Coffee Chat with Catherine Hardwicke
events.description: Catherine Hardwicke (SFiFF 2023 Visionary Awardee) is the director of Thirteen, Lords of Dogtown, and Twilight, whose work spans award-winning indies to billion-dollar global franchises that launched the careers of a generation’s biggest stars. Catherine will speak about her newest film Street Smart (SFiFF 2026). Moderated by Alexandria Bombach.

films.name: Ceremony
films.description: When the Nuxalk trace their vanished ooligan through settler tapes and a land claim filed the very day smallpox arrived, their radio station becomes courtroom, confessional and conjuring ground; there, an older law insists: the fish and the people return together or not at all. CEREMONY was made for the Nuxalk community, who asked for this story to be told, and that twelve-year responsibility shaped every part of its creation. Winner of the audience award at SXSW. Director Banchi Hanuse in attendance.

films.name: Street Smart
films.description: A lively group of street kids in Venice Beach help each other chase their dreams in STREET SMART. When the crew finds out their camp will shut down and a new girl pressures them into bending (or breaking) their moral code, it threatens to tear apart this makeshift family. The group forges unbreakable bonds and redefines what it means to be a family. Director Catherine Hardwicke in attendance.

films.name: Daughters of the Forest
films.description: DAUGHTERS OF THE FOREST takes place deep in Mexico’s forests, where two Indigenous mycologists embark on an unexpected, sometimes speculative exploration of the realities of two Indigenous communities and the fungi in the forests of Mexico, inviting them to reconsider the perceptions and experiences of both the human and non-human inhabitants of our world.

films.name: La Gradiva
films.description: A group of French high school students travel to Naples on a school trip to discover the ruins of Pompeii and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in LA GRADIVA. There, they are drawn into a dizzying descent. One by one, they are swept up in desire and anger until they surrender to them completely. Winner of the Grand Prize (Ami Paris Grand Prize) at the Cannes Film Festival Critics' Week.

events.name: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York

films.name: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
films.description: In THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK, Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family. A Sony Pictures Classics release

films.name: Paper Tiger
films.description: In James Gray’s deeply felt and intense drama PAPER TIGER, two brothers (Adam Driver and Miles Teller) become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences. A NEON Release

events.description: This screening is in screen 5 at Sky Railyard
