films.name: UnderTheInfluence
films.description: In #UNDERTHEINFLUENCE, Brooke Haven (Cassidy Freeman) and Chelsea Haven (Alexandra Renzo), the daughters of the first mommy blogger, agree to star in a reality TV show based on their childhood fame as the daughters of the first real mommy blogger. They quickly learn reality is negotiable, relationships are for sale, and sisterhood is the only thing that can save them.

events.name: Closing Night Party
events.description: As we close out the festival explore the exquisite cocktails of As Above So Below, enjoy empanadas by Cafecito Santa Fe, dance, and say good bye to all the wonderful friends you made during the festival. 21+

films.name: Ni-Naadamaadiz: Red Power Rising
films.description: Despite it lasting 28 days in 1974, there is only eight minutes of footage about an Indigenous youth-led armed occupation in Kenora, Ontario. NI-NAADAMAADIZ: RED POWER RISING follows the charismatic Louis Cameron and the Ojibwe Warriors Society, who fought for Indigenous human rights and were joined by members of the American Indian Movement, who crossed the border to join directly after Wounded Knee.

films.name: Elephants in the Fog
films.description: ELEPHANTS IN THE FOG follows a Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest inhabited by wild elephants. Pirati, the matriarch of a Kinnar community, dreams of escaping to live with the man she loves. But when one of her daughters goes missing, she must investigate and choose between her desire for freedom and her responsibilities to her community. Nepal's submission to the 2027 Academy Awards®

films.name: Little House on the Prairie
films.description: In THE LITTLE HOUSE ON THE PRAIRIE (Season 1 Episode 7), the Osage convene for a crucial tribal council where the future of their land and Laura's bond with Good Eagle hang in the balance. Q&A with director Sydney Freeland and Osage Cultural Consultant Julie Okeefe.

events.description: THIS SCREENING IS IN ALBUQUERQUE

films.name: Amygdala
films.description: When Zoe is attacked by a mysterious woman and begins to experience strange visions, she has only minutes to get help or else uncover the mystery behind the madness that surrounds her in AMYGDALA.

films.name: Frontera
films.description: FRONTERA follows a boy fleeing a tragedy in the US who crosses south into post-revolutionary 1923 Sonora, Mexico, taking refuge with a healer woman who prepares for the spiritual chaos of a solar eclipse. As he fumbles to outlast his grief, she readies herself to meet the total darkness.

films.name: Last Ditch
films.description: Near the end of the 1847 Taos Revolt, two rogues hiding in an irrigation ditch must choose between freedom and risking their lives one last time to save a child from a brutal U.S. army scout.

films.name: Meathead
films.description: The titular MEATHEAD is expecting a few easy bucks from a boring house-sitting job. If only they’d read the house rules! This darkly comedic horror short satirizes youthful apathy and the soul-sucking jobs we take just to survive.

films.name: Red Razor On Soft Skin
films.description: RED RAZOR ON SOFT SKIN is a giallo horror short film about a timid son forced by his mother to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. From writer-director-editor Luca Silver comes a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction, hand-crafted by Dust Wave Collective in Albuquerque, NM.

films.name: Shroomery
films.description: When Lacey's boyfriend, Miles, buys the wrong type of 'shrooms' in the hopes of reviving their ailing relationship, the two must team up to fight off a growth of malicious mushrooms that have overtaken their refrigerator in SHROOMERY.

films.name: Valentina's Tax
films.description: An aspiring finance-bro assumes he’s in control when a woman walks into his bar, but her presence is no accident; it’s a calculated move to collect a debt in VALENTINA'S TAX.

films.name: We Didn't Know Why
films.description: Two women, speeding down a lone desert highway, confront death, birth, and rebirth in WE DIDN'T KNOW WHY.
